answer_1.quote: In this work, we aim to address the challenges of generating open-ended questions from input consisting of multiple sentences... we design a type-aware framework ... built on large pre-trained BART ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated questions with BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE-L ...

answer_4.quote: We hire three annotators ... to evaluate 80 groups of questions generated by four selected models ... annotators are asked to rank the four models ... on three aspects of diversities: type, syntax, and answer content ... we also ask the annotators to rank ... on appropriateness, answerability, and scope ... overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges rank models on type diversity, syntax diversity, answer-content diversity, appropriateness, answerability, scope, and overall quality.
